name: Standard help tabs
description: Turns on tabs, gives every chart a commentary header and Indian-format tooltips, and adds How-to, FAQ and Methodology tabs.

steps.title: How to use
steps.markdown:
# How to use this dashboard

1. Use the **filter pane** on the left to narrow the data.
2. **Hover** over a chart to see exact values.
3. **Double-click** a bar or slice to drill down. Use the breadcrumb above the chart to go back up.
4. Press **Alt + →** / **Alt + ←** to move between tabs.

steps.title: FAQ
steps.markdown:
# Frequently asked questions

## How often is the data refreshed?
Monthly, on the 5th working day.

## Who do I contact about a number?
The dashboard owner listed on the Methodology tab.
